result:
These queries are written from the page alone and none were run. Where the page didn't settle a detail, I assumed the following:
- `sort` with no modifier sorts plain values.
- `at` accepts a vector index.
- `sum` of an empty vector is 0.
- `groupBy` accepts a quote key.

R1: filter ~(if (/active) ~(if (/address | type | eq ::map) ~(/address | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") ~(false)) ~(false)) * /name | sort
R2: filter ~(at :age | type | eq ::number) * /age | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~/customer * (* /items | flat * (mul /qty /price) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(if (at :assignee | type | eq ::map) ~(/assignee/login) ~("unassigned")) * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number
R6: [(/dependencies | entries) (/devDependencies | entries)] | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort
R7: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " " | {:path /2 :status (/3 | parseJson)}) | filter ~(/status | gte 500) * /path | distinct | sort
R8: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") * (/4 | split "ms" | first | parseJson) | avg | round 0
R9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~/1 * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
R10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split "," | at 3 | coalesce "" | split ";") | flat | filter ~(count | gt 0) * lower | distinct | sort
R11: lines * trim | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) * (split "=" | [(/0 | trim) (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)]) | filter ~(/0 | startsWith "DB_") * [(/0 | drop 3 | lower | keyword) /1] | tag ::map
R12: /services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :enabled | eq true) * {:name (/0 | keyword) :url (/1 | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")} | sort ~/name
R13: {:total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * (/meta | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple" "banana" "apple" "Cherry" "BANANA" "date" "Elder" "cherry" "fig" "Apple"] * lower | groupBy ~(/) * count | filter ~(gt 1) | keys * keyword | sort
